::: {#def-permutation-equivariance}

#### Permutation equivariance

A function $f$ from sequences of vectors to sequences of vectors of the same length is **permutation equivariant**
when reordering its input reorders its output the same way:
$f(\pi(\matr{X})) = \pi(f(\matr{X}))$ for every sequence $\matr{X}$ and every reordering $\pi$ of its positions
[@zaheer2017deep, section 2].
[Self-attention](#def-self-attention) is permutation equivariant,
as @sol-reverse found for one reordering.

:::
